description: This file defines a caching and tracing utility for agent interactions, including types, configuration, and functions for recording trace events and wrapping stream functions.

methods.name: resolveCacheTraceConfig
methods.description: Resolves the cache trace configuration based on environment variables, configuration, and defaults.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a queued file writer for the specified file path.

methods.name: stableStringify
methods.description: Serializes a value into a stable JSON string, handling special types and circular references.

methods.name: digest
methods.description: Creates a SHA-256 hash digest of a serialized value.

methods.name: summarizeMessages
methods.description: Generates a summary of agent messages, including count, roles, fingerprints, and digest.

methods.name: createCacheTrace
methods.description: Creates and returns a CacheTrace object if enabled, with methods to record stages and wrap stream functions.
